Chapter 192: Chapter 2 Rule Crystal (Subscribe Please)

Chapter 192: Chapter 2 Rule Crystal (Subscribe Please)

Looking at Mr. Lu whose eyes were shining brightly, Lin Yuan felt a flicker of oddness in his eyes.

When it came to understanding the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, not to mention Mr. Lu, even those top-tier evolvers from the human civilization wouldn’t surpass Lin Yuan.

After all, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was created and pioneered by Lin Yuan himself, how could others compare?

It was as if Lin Yuan had set the questions, and he alone decided what the answers were. Could outsiders dare challenge the question setter?

Of course, the identity of the founder of an evolutionary path was immensely significant, especially for the currently popular Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Naturally, Lin Yuan would not admit his identity here.

...

You should know, in the Chikun Star Domain, most evolvers and high-ranking citizens unanimously believed that the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was developed as an experimental product by some top-ranked evolver scholar.

What is an evolver scholar? They are the absolute elite of human civilization, unchallenged both in terms of personal strength and contributions to human civilization.

Those from different species outside human civilization were all desperate to assassinate an evolver scholar.

An evolver scholar might have never been to the frontier battlefield, but their influence on it was profound through the evolutionary paths, secret techniques, and even technological achievements they developed.

This could even decide the outcome of local wars.

Unfortunately, the importance of evolver scholars was known to the different species, and naturally to the human race; every evolver scholar was tightly protected.

Moreover, evolver scholars were not weak, they too had their own means of protection.

The different species couldn’t even pin down where an evolver scholar was, let alone assassinate one.

If Lin Yuan were to expose himself as the founder of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, the different species would certainly launch an assassination without hesitation.

Even if it cost several sixth-rank powerhouses who had infiltrated human territories, they would still fiercely target Lin Yuan.

Why was the Martial Path Evolutionary Path considered an experimental product by an evolver scholar?

Why hadn’t other evolutionary paths been subject to such speculation?

It was because of the high potential of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, which was astonishingly high.

A regular founder of an evolutionary path simply couldn’t create such a high-level path.

Only evolver scholars, who transcended through time, possessing vast knowledge and also stood in high positions, could create such potent evolutionary paths.

If the different species knew the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was created by an evolver who wasn’t even sixth rank, they certainly wouldn’t allow Lin Yuan to continue to grow.

The Martial Path Evolutionary Path has the potential to grow into an eighth-layer evolutionary path, and Lin Yuan had a slim chance of becoming the next evolver scholar of human civilization.

Assassinating Lin Yuan, even at a great cost, would be much lighter than facing the consequences on the battlefield due to Lin Yuan’s research and inventions, which could lead to the fall of untold numbers of alien strong ones.

….

Lin Yuan’s thoughts converged.

Listening to Mr. Lu’s ‘opinions’.

“I think the Martial Path Evolutionary Path is not purely based on vital energy but integrates spiritual power, soul power, and mental strength among others…”

Mr. Lu spoke eloquently.

The president of the Canglan Evolution Academy nodded slightly.

Feeling that what Mr. Lu said made sense.

Of course, this did not mean that what Lin Yuan said was not reasonable.

Studying the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, everyone has their own views and insights.

That’s completely normal.

Indeed, Lin Yuan’s evolutive talent could be regarded as the best in Canglan Star.

He had reached the Fourth Rank before the age of a hundred.

But precisely because of this.

Most of Lin Yuan’s time was undoubtedly spent practicing.

In contrast, although Mr. Lu’s evolutive talent did not match Lin Yuan’s.

In recent years, since the Martial Path Evolutionary Path entered the Canglan Evolution Ranking, he began his research.

A deeper understanding of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was only natural.

“Alright.”

“Both Mr. Lu and Mr. Lin have their valid points.”

“Although everyone has different views, we are all serving human civilization. Mr. Lin, please don’t mind. Mr. Lu is like that, sometimes even daring to challenge the president…”

Professor Chu chuckled, smoothing things over.

“It’s okay…..”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

He actually didn’t mind Mr. Lu’s questioning earlier.

Mainly because Lin Yuan found it hard to care, as every word Mr. Lu said was praising the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, and praising the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was essentially praising Lin Yuan as its founder, right?

“That’s good then.”

Professor Chu nodded approvingly.

…

Returning to the Virtual World Personal Space.

Lin Yuan contemplated the discussion he just had with those professors,

mentioning their views and understandings of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, which in turn gave him more insights and feelings.

Practicing and learning are never done in isolation, occasionally one must also interact with the outside world.

Against-Heaven’s Understanding is based on the depth of understanding and Enlightenment Lin Yuan reaches at his level.

The more Lin Yuan knew, and the broader his vision, the greater the effect of his Against-Heaven’s Understanding.

…

After examining himself.

Lin Yuan noticed a little red dot on the Founders’ Virtual World category.

“Someone contacted me?”

Lin Yuan instantly understood what this red dot meant.

During his fourth traversal, in order to avoid disturbances, he had shut down any means to contact him.

‘Message alert’ in Founders’ World was naturally included.

“Who would contact me?”

Lin Yuan was curious; he was a newcomer to Founders’ World, knowing no one and having no friends.

Soon.

Lin Yuan entered Founders’ Virtual World.

“Is it the person who posted that ‘post’?”

Lin Yuan’s expression became slightly serious.
